## Notes

Released February 1989; goal-oriented, time-limited scenarios ending in win or loss, added at Broderbund's suggestion to make it more like a traditional game; disasters including floods, tornadoes, fires, earthquakes, and monsters; Super NES version adds advisor Dr. Wright who reports city problems.
